notes.title: More News on Chapter 2
notes.notes:
Hello investigators!

First off, we want to sincerely apologize for the long silence and delay in releasing Chapter 2. 2024 has been much wilder than we ever could have predicted, especially with the release of PANICORE as you might know. With this announcement we mainly want to tell you one thing: While being silent about it, we've worked on Chapter 2 and it will happen!

[h2]Current Progress on Chapter 2[/h2]

We're aiming for the next chapter to be better than anything we've been doing so far. Here’s what you should know right now:

[list]
[*] Estimated percentage of progress: We'd say around 70% of the chapter is done right now, missing parts are mainly last parts of the chapter and a transition into the game's current story flow as well as testing & polishing phases
[*] New Content: the chapter will not be the only new content to the game, you will also find new content in the forest which will be available in the public beta soon
[*] Public Beta Updates: While no new content has been added yet, small teasers for Chapter 2 can already be found in the beta version. We have also implemented several technical improvements, a full voice chat overhaul, a complete menu overhaul and a new UI including a better controller support. This version has been updated frequently in the last few weeks so make sure to switch if you want to experience current updates to the game!
[*] Saving & Loading Rework: In our last announcement, we mentioned potential issues with the saving/loading system. We are happy to tell you that we've successfully reworked the system without losing previous save files, so your progress from Chapter 1 should be safe!
[*] Performance Boost: We have managed to improve performance, especially for lower-end computers.
[*] Connection Issues: If you've been experiencing problems connecting with other players, we highly recommend trying out the public beta. This will help us gather valuable feedback that Chapter 2 will benefit a lot from.
[/list]

[h2]When Will Chapter 2 Be Released?[/h2]

We would love to release the chapter within this quarter. However, despite being late we are still taking our time to ensure it meets our own standards and surpasses the quality we’ve delivered so far. We don't want to release the chapter "just to release something" which is hopefully understandable. Your patience means the world to us, and we promise it will be worth the wait! If not during this quarter, we can guarantee to release it in the second quarter of this year.

Once again, we apologize for the long time this is taking. Thank you for sticking with us on this journey. Your support, feedback, and enthusiasm continue to drive us forward. Stay tuned for more updates!

Your two brothers at ZTEK Studio

notes.title: Chapter 2 News
notes.notes:
Investigators!

With this news announcement, we would like to give you an overview of what's happening with The Devourer & what else is happening around it. We'll be as transparent as possible with the informaton we're giving you.

To start off, we would like to apologize for the long wait. For all players that have been around here since the demo's release, they might remember that the [b]implementation of Chapter 1[/b] took around [b]6-7 months[/b]. This being said, we assume around the same amount of time needed for Chapter 2 including playtesting and bug fixing. For you this would mean the expected [b]update for Chapter 2[/b] [b]should be around Mid-End of May[/b]! 

[b]What can you expect?[/b]
[list]
[*] Of course, Chapter 2 as the next story chapter which will have its own flair to it. You can again expect around 2 hours of playtime in this chapter - more if you want to walk around the forest and do everything, but as done with Chapter 1, this will have its own location - which we are showing you in a few screenshots attached to this post :)
[*] New elements in the forest to discover
[*] New dangers / entities
[*] Fully redesigned menu system including technical fixes
[*] Reworked saving / loading system - which unfortunately means you'll need to play the intro with the graves etc. again, but [b]Chapter 2 will be accessible without playing Chapter 1[/b]. During Early Access development the save file structure will change which will probably always come with saves getting corrupted
[*] Fully reworked lobby system, the lobby is a playable 3D lobby now
[*] Reworked Voice Chat system so it is fully functional
[/list]

[b]What else should you know?[/b]

By now you might also know that we have decided to develop our second title PANICORE while going on with The Devourer. This has multiple reasons:
[list]
[*] We wanted you guys to have something made by us to play inbetween chapter waits
[*] We wanted to improve our skills: this one is huge for us, for example a fully functional and better voice chat has been implemented for PANICORE which The Devourer will benefit from. And this is just one of MANY examples developing PANICORE has helped us with!
[*] We wanted to grow: With the release of PANICORE's demo our Discord server has DOUBLED its size in around TWO WEEKS. A portion of these players also know of The Devourer and played it now!
[*] The game will assist The Devourer's future development financially
[/list]

PANICORE will be released right before or after Chapter 2 as a [b]FULL RELEASE[/b] which means it shouldn't need too much work after.

Thank you for your patience and happy gaming!
Your team at ZTEK Studio

notes.title: Reasons for crashes and how to (maybe) get rid of them
notes.notes:
Hello Investigators!

We're sorry that so many of you are still experiencing crashes! Currently, we have been reported 3 different types of crashes:

[list]
[*] GPU crashes (include a message about D3D12 / DX12), for this one try out the other launch options (DX11 and Vulkan)
[*] FATAL ERROR (voice chat is causing this)
[*] Level loading crashes (short error message, but these only happen if you quit the game)
[/list]

We would like to [b]invite you to try out the public beta branch[/b] if you encounter any of these crashes! We're updating the beta branch multiple times daily and would love to know if the fixes work out for you!

After some testing, we will upload the public beta to the main branch (will take 1-2 days probably).

If crashes especially due to Voice chat keep happening we will take it out very soon until it is stable! We're also constantly working on optimizations to reduce the GPU crashes!

Have a spooky day! :)

notes.title: Small Halloween Update
notes.notes:
Hello Investigators!

We're pretty new to all of this, but we still wanted to do something small for Halloween! 

We would like to welcome you to the [b]Pumpkin Hunt[/b]!

[b]What to do in the update[/b]:

[list]
[*] Find the happy looking pumpkin in the cabin at the spawn point and interact with it
[*] Find all other happy looking pumpkins in the [b]FOREST[/b]
[*] Get your EMF and EMF Type Reader (Spirit Box looking gadget)
[*] Watch out for signals & the type [b]"Paranormal Pumpkin"[/b]
[/list]

PRO TIP: The pumpkins are distributed around the forest, but are all easily reachable, you don't have to check all the boundaries of the map!

[b]After completing the hunt:[/b]
[list]
[*] You get a [b]seasonal achievement[/b]
[*] [i]Restart the session[/i] and check the cabin at the start for a [b]small reward[/b]
[*] Everytime YOU host a game the reward will always be there from now on! :)
[/list]

The update will be online [b]until 07.11.2023 7pm CEST[/b]. 

Let the hunt begin and Happy Halloween!

notes.title: Apology to our VR players!
notes.notes:
Hello Investigators!

First, we would like to say thank you to anyone who has tried out the demo and the Early Access release! Also thank you so much for leaving a review on Steam, it helps a lot! We are really happy that a majority of you guys enjoy our game!

As some of you might know, communication with our players is really really important to us and we have some things to say: 

We would like to [b]apologize to our VR players[/b] as the Steam store page was set up incorrectly telling you VR is fully supported - the VR version is currently [b]only experimental[/b] and may work fine for some people, but it is in development and still in early stages! The store page was [b]NOT[/b] meant to display it like that! So that is totally our fault and we again apologize for that.

Meanwhile, we have the following proposals to our VR players that bought the game for ONLY the VR version:
[list]
[*] We don't think it is fair to you and we humbly ask you to refund the game until VR is in a playable state
[*] OR as an alternative, we would be ABSOLUTELY thankful if you could join our [url=https://discord.gg/5Jp46KY9sd]Discord server[/url] and join us as Beta testers, together we can improve VR much better!
[/list]

Thank you for reading, we WILL deliver better in the future!

Happy Halloween!

Your team at ZTEK Studio

notes.title: The Devourer: Hunted Souls Early Access v0.4.0 Release Notes
notes.notes:
Thank you for your continued support and feedback during the demo! We’re excited to read your reviews, this is the start of something much greater! :) Please visit our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2309400/discussions/]community forums[/url] to discuss the latest updates and share your thoughts on The Devourer: Hunted Souls. Join our [url=https://discord.gg/5Jp46KY9sd]Discord[/url] to directly contact us and our community! Happy exploring and Happy Halloween!

[b]The Devourer: Hunted Souls - Release Notes (Version 0.4.0)[/b] [i]Date: October, 26th 2023[/i]

[b]New Features[/b]

[list]
[*] Introducing Story Chapter 1 with new items, locations, puzzles, story elements and more to explore!
[*] Added different start to game and changed some locations for demo players to have something new!
[*] Added new gadget: the Paranormal Radar
[*] Added new functionality to EMF Type Reader: Multilingual Speech Recognition
[*] Added the possibility to respawn certain items if you lose them
[*] Added a group inventory on the clipboard for shared items
[*] Added DLSS 3
[*] Added FSR 2.2
[*] Added Steam Achievements
[*] Added option to remap keys on keyboard
[*] Added Bodycam intensity slider
[*] Added VHS effect checkbox
[*] Added option to turn off chromatic aberration
[*] Added option to disable bloom
[*] Added chromatic aberration intensity slider
[*] Added voice chat device input selection
[*] Added renaming save files
[*] Added option to “untoggle” Sprint in VR
[*] Added a "shared notes" section to the task clipboard
[/list]

[b]Gameplay Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Jumping out of crouching is enabled now
[*] Interacting with an item when your hands are free makes to take the item directly into your hand now
[*] Interacting in VR is more convenient now
[*] Less intense head bob, the other one was really strong making people mostly feel nauseous
[*] Climbing ladders is now a possibility
[*] When multiple interactable elements were in your line of sight you interacted with them all - now items have higher priority making interactions much more convenient
[*] VR players have lines that show where they point at now
[*] VR players have smaller item slots now, preventing them from interacting with their items unwillingly
[/list]

[b]General Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Changed AI damage and speeds (depending on difficulty)
[*] AI behaviour balancing changes (depending on difficulty)
[*] Stamina affects your sprinting speed now, the more you sprint at once, the slower you become over time
[*] New Tutorial
[*] Shannon’s ability cooldown has been incereased
[*] Tau’s ability sprint speed has been reduced
[*] Task clipboard has pages now
[*] Characters will heal over time if you’re lower than half your health (except on Devourer Mode difficulty)
[*] Changed character movement in general, more realistic acceleration and jump heights
[*] Bug Fixes
[*] Fixed a bug that made Shannon’s ability useless
[*] Fixed a bug that still made language selection not work after a restart
[*] Fixed a bug that made some items get stuck in your hands making them unusable
[*] Fixed a bug that disabled camera movement after using an interactable
[*] Fixed a bug that looped the ambient of the death area on everyone after one person was sent there
[*] Fixed a bug that caused timeouts and sent people to the lobby
[*] Fixed a bug that made your character mesh stay invisible when you were interacting with stuff and entities catch you
[*] Fixed a bug where VR players didn’t actually crouch
[*] Removed ingame chat due to it causing bugs, will come back later
[/list]

[b]Known Issues:[/b]

[list]
[*] Lobbies of different regions can’t be seen: To fix this, change the Download Region in your Steam settings to your friend’s, use Steam’s invitation system or the invitation system inside the game
[*] Clients disconnecting cause the whole lobby to close
[*] Rarely, Save Games become corrupted and disappear
[*] Introduction Video/Audio might get out of sync
[*] Introduction Video and credits video can lag / not play
[*] Items can be stuck in your hip inventory without being accessible
[*] Character hair sometimes go crazy
[*] Some abilities don't work in VR yet
[*] Sometimes, notes are not shown on clients
[*] Landscape collisions are sometimes not accurate
[/list]

[*] Added clipboard item for VR players.

[i]Improvements:[/i]

[*] Upgrade to Unreal Engine 5.2
[*] A lot of textures have been changed to consume less VRAM.
[*] Added a symbol to indicate auto saving.
[*] Players can now sprint out of crouching.
[*] Characters will pull their hands back if you are near a wall
[*] Pressing escape now exits interactables.
[*] You can now see who is ready in the lobby.
[*] Redesigned settings menu, should be more understandable now.

[list]
[*] Clicking on the "Find Sessions" button now triggers finding sessions as intended.
[*] Clients can now see current tasks in the lobby.
[*] New joining clients can now see the current loaded save game and difficulty in the lobby.
[*] Potential fix for low frames in the lobby that could cause VR widgets to still be visible in non-VR.
[*] Settings menu: Some settings had wrong default values, which have been fixed.
[*] Settings menu: DLSS/TSR now deactivate the scaling options when turned off.
[*] Flashlight and tablet item no longer stutter when turning the camera.
[/list]

[i]General Changes:[/i]

[list]
[*] Reworked death system, no maze anymore, and should be easier to understand. If every character dies, the losing screen is triggered immediately instead of teleporting players to the zombie area.
[*] Shorter respawn time for players who died.
[*] Disabled Instanced Stereo, since it somehow caused crashes for people playing non VR
[/list]

[i]Language additions:[/i]
[list]
[*] Added Chinese translations
[/list]

[i]Known Issues:[/i]

[list]
[*] AMD GPUs may experience visual glitches (everything is pink and/or bright).
[*] VR players can't change the hand they hold an item in without dropping the item.
[*] VR players crouching only changes the animation to crouch but not their actual height (this means VR players can't actually crouch).
[*] VR players that die and drop items can't see their hands until they pick up and drop another item.
[*] VR players may experience camera shakes when the host is playing in non-VR.
[/list]

notes.title: The Devourer: Hunted Souls Demo Playthrough (chat with devs!)
notes.notes:
As the Whispering Pines witnessed a series of mysterious disappearances, a creeping dread settled over the forest. Some say they saw shadows moving in the trees, others reported feeling watched by unseen eyes. But one thing was certain: something in the forest was getting stronger with each missing person.

When a group of skilled paranormal investigators is called in to unravel the mystery of the Whispering Pines, they quickly realize that they are not alone in the haunted forest. Girded with their paranormal investigation equipment, they set out to uncover the secrets of the cursed woods and the fate of the missing people.

As the team delves deeper into the mystery of the Whispering Pines, they will need all their skills and courage to survive the terrors that lurk in the shadows. But with each clue they uncover, they come closer to discovering the truth behind the disappearances and the sinister force at work in the forest.

Play as a paranormal investigator in our hybrid between first person survival and psychological horror game. Investigate a haunted forest with up to 5 players CO-OP vs AI and try to lift the curse. The forest is active... time may run out. Will you survive or will you lose your soul?
